format: Studio / Custom events: ordinal_rank@1 ballots and studio_ordinal_majority@1 placement with tie chain
requirement: DanceFlow policy (not any governing body's rule): each judge ranks every entry once (ordinal_rank@1); placement by strict-majority cutoff (OM-A); ties ordered by (1) more judges at or below the cutoff, (2) lower sum of those ordinals, (3) share the placement with numbering that skips (2, 2, 4). Owner decisions D-OM-1..3 (2026-10-24), adopted as DanceFlow Studio rules with no compliance claim. Preserved unchanged by OD-13 Option A.
enforcement_point: Results engine (studio_ordinal_majority@1) and ballot format ordinal_rank@1; specification docs/competition/engine-spec-ordinal-majority.md.

tests.name: F-OM-09 shared placement skips the number

interpretation_notes: Behavior is approved and unit-tested as written, but the scoring-disclosure labels required by OD-13 do not exist yet (see the disclosure spec), and per the audit README a policy row is only verified_compliant once label, approval and test are all in place. Must never be described as UCWDC, NDCA or WSDC scoring. OD-01 (PR 832) keeps unverified body-compliant results from being published for body-declared events.
decision_refs: OD-13 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option A: preserve DanceFlow Studio scoring; retrospective audit PR #795)
